Ripple and 120+ crypto players stand together to fight for the passage of the Clarity Act. JP Morgan says banks won't touch crypto until the DEFI exploits get fixed and prevented. 

Banks want 60 more days to digest the Clarity Act language. This is an obvious stall tactic by the banks to run out the clock. An IPO related to Ethereum got delayed, Kalshi wants to expand their revenue stream and Tether is freezing money from some naughty players. 

Lobstr wallet from Stellar XLM is now integrated with the XRP Ledger. Tillis is also blocking Warsh's nomination and the Clarity Act. Way to go, you get a gold star, loser. 

XRP and SoFI, this is a confirmed story about a traditional bank getting into XRP and bringing it together with TRADEFI! Ripple is happy with the SoFi announcement. Keel and Hive pivot from BTC to AI and the stock price is reflecting that change. 

XRP and XLM are bracing for further delays with the Clarity Act. Brad Garlinghouse has something nice to say about Paul Atkins and the SEC, but it's just words, garble garble. Meanwhile the Strait of Hormuz is closed and the cease fire deal is expiring. US, Isreal and Iran drama is keeping oil prices high which is leading to inflation expectations. BTC and Ethereum had inflows, while the Clarity Act gets delayed because the banks aren't happy with competition.
